cover_letter:
Dear Chillafish team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content Creator position. Your job description reads like a day in my ideal workflow: dreaming up a campaign, shooting and editing it, then digging into the numbers to see what worked. I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, and I've spent the last few years building websites, writing SEO content, and using AI tools to make creative production faster.

At Episto, I handle on-page SEO and content for client websites, publishing blog posts and pages in WordPress while tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. For mirook.com, I built and optimized a multi-page site for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical audits that measurably improved search health. My freelance work includes baverok.com, where I designed and coded a landing page with a WebGL hero, and Shopify stores like harwindtf.com, where I manage product catalogues and write blog content. These projects have taught me to ship scrappy versions quickly and iterate based on performance data.

On the creative side, I'm comfortable with Canva, Premiere, and CapCut, and I have a strong eye for storytelling and visuals. I use LLMs daily for research and content creation, and I'm eager to learn Google Ads and Meta campaigns—I already have Google Ads Search and GA4 certifications. I'm fluent in English and have some Dutch, and I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Antwerp.

What draws me to Chillafish is the playful brand and the chance to own content from idea to results. I'd love to bring my mix of creative production and performance curiosity to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
